aboutPage.meta.description: HatchGrab was started by Dominic Bonini, who built Village Foodie to find out which food trucks were coming to his village. It’s a small company, and he runs it himself.
aboutPage.meta.title: About — HatchGrab
aboutPage.story.hatchgrab: The more trucks I looked at, the more I thought they deserved better tools: something built for a business that’s somewhere different every day, not a restaurant with a fixed address. That’s why I started HatchGrab.
aboutPage.story.small: It’s a small company and I run it myself. If you get in touch, you’ll hear back from me, not a support queue.
aboutPage.story.village: I live in a village. Food trucks visit, but I never knew which one was coming, or when, without digging through Facebook.
aboutPage.story.villageFoodie: So I built Village Foodie, a simple way to see which food trucks are coming to villages near you.

featuresPage.detail.advanced_reporting: Break down your sales by date range, item and event to see what really sells.
featuresPage.detail.auto_accept: Online orders are accepted automatically — no need to confirm each one.
featuresPage.detail.branded_qr_code: Add your logo to your QR code.
featuresPage.detail.buzzer_tracking: Link a buzzer number to an order when you hand it out, so you know which buzzer goes with which order.
featuresPage.detail.customer_display: A screen customers can see, showing order numbers and when they’re ready.
featuresPage.detail.discovery_map_listin: Your food truck appears on the public HatchGrab map so nearby customers can find you.
featuresPage.detail.embed_schedule: Show your upcoming dates on your own website. Each one links straight through to its order page.
featuresPage.detail.event_types: Create your own event types, with custom prices and settings for events and festivals.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_app: The fullest way to use HatchGrab: a live kitchen screen, and the only way to keep taking orders when you lose signal.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_capacity: Set how much your kitchen can cook at a time and how long it takes. Once a slot is full, customers can no longer pick it.
featuresPage.detail.loyalty_stamp_cards: Reward repeat customers with digital stamp loyalty cards — stamps collected and redeemed automatically.
featuresPage.detail.meal_deals_upsells: Bundle items into deals and offer extras at checkout to increase the average order.
featuresPage.detail.messenger_instagram_: Same as WhatsApp auto-replies, for Messenger and Instagram enquiries.
featuresPage.detail.multi_device_kitchen: Use several screens — counter and kitchen — all showing the same live orders.
featuresPage.detail.multi_user_access: Give your staff their own logins, with the right level of access.
featuresPage.detail.offline_protection: If you lose signal, online ordering pauses so customers don’t place orders you wouldn’t see. The iPhone, iPad and Android app lets you keep taking orders offline; the web dashboard needs a connection.
featuresPage.detail.online_payments: Take card payment upfront when customers order online, via Stripe.
featuresPage.detail.preorder_deadline: Set a cut-off time for items that need notice.
featuresPage.detail.private_events: Add private events that don’t show on the map, with their own private ordering link and QR code.
featuresPage.detail.qr_code: A printable QR code that opens your menu and ordering page.
featuresPage.detail.schedule_import: We fill your schedule automatically — from your website, or a photo you already post on Facebook. You just review and confirm.
featuresPage.detail.sms_order_alerts: Text customers automatically by SMS when their order is ready.
featuresPage.detail.social_media_posts: Upload your designs — we automatically add your dates, places and times for each week and each event.
featuresPage.detail.sold_out_toggle: Mark any item sold out in one tap — it is greyed out for customers straight away.
featuresPage.detail.stock_countdown: Set a stock count: it goes down with each order, then the item sells out automatically.
featuresPage.detail.tap_to_pay: Accept contactless card payments on a supported phone, with no separate card machine.
featuresPage.detail.ticket_printing: Print order tickets on a Bluetooth or wired printer in the kitchen.
featuresPage.detail.time_slot_selection: Customers pick a collection time slot, spreading demand across your service.
featuresPage.detail.walkup_orders: Take and manage orders at the counter, paid on your own card terminal.
featuresPage.detail.web_dashboard: Run your service from the browser of any phone, tablet or laptop.
featuresPage.detail.whatsapp_auto_replie: WhatsApp auto-replies to enquiries about your menu and schedule.
